note: The build half of per-invocation identity: the env rewrite of ADR 0010 step 5. Each case replaces process.env with an object, as a harness's per-invocation view does, and checks that every way of reading the environment through Bun reads it. The isolation cases WA-31/a and WA-31/b are the harness's (W1, C3b).

entries.source:
